```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Load the packages needed to read, merge, and save the developmental 10x data.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  cache = TRUE,
  autodep = TRUE,
  cache.comments = FALSE,
  cache.path = file.path(
    here::here("results", "cache", "publication_pipeline"),
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input())), "/")
  )
)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(Seurat)
})
```


Get and process data from the specified directories
```{r get-H5-files}
# Read the developmental 10x H5 files.
dev_base_dir <- params$raw_h5_dir
dev_sample_dirs <- list.dirs(dev_base_dir, full.names = TRUE, recursive = FALSE)

# Define the sample order.
sample_order <- c(
  "p1_F_2_counts", "p1_F_counts", "p1_M_2_counts", "p1_M_counts",
  "p15_F_counts", "p15_R1_counts", "p22_F_2_counts", "p22_F_counts",
  "p22_M_2_counts", "p22_M_counts", "p3_F_counts", "p3_M_counts",
  "p5_R1_counts", "p5_R2_counts", "p8_M_counts", "p8_R1_counts"
)
dev_sample_dirs <- dev_sample_dirs[match(sample_order, basename(dev_sample_dirs))]

# Match each sample name to its raw-count file.
seurat_objects <- lapply(dev_sample_dirs, function(dir_path) {
  sample_name <- basename(dir_path)

  # Read the labeled raw-count file for this sample.
  raw_h5_file <- file.path(dir_path, "outs", "raw_feature_bc_matrix.h5")
  count_matrix <- Read10X_h5(raw_h5_file)

  # Create one Seurat object per sample using the 100-feature minimum.
  CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = count_matrix,
    min.features = 200,
    project = sample_name
  )
})
```


```{r combine}
# Combine the sample objects into the list that will be merged below.
combined_seurat_objects <- c(seurat_objects)
```


```{r merge}
# Merge every sample into the single Seurat object used by the QC notebook.
seurat_objects_list <- unlist(combined_seurat_objects, recursive = FALSE)
cell_ids <- names(seurat_objects_list)
x <- seurat_objects_list[[1]]
y <- seurat_objects_list[-1]
merged_seurat <- merge(x = x, 
                       y = y,
                       add.cell.id = cell_ids)
```


```{r save_it, cache=FALSE}
# Save the merged object.
if (isTRUE(params$save_outputs)) {
  saveRDS(merged_seurat, file.path(params$output_dir, "001_Dev_merged.rds"))
}
```
